text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle pulls off running on dirt<n>without a hitch.
With her gradually<n>getting a feel for competing on
tracks,<n>she's in excellent form.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We're ready for the challenge... but<n>there are other
affairs to attend to<n>first! Taiki Shuttle is looking to
celebrate our hard work with a party.
